title: The final
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The instructor's final: a thesis, defended. Wood hands in twelve weeks of digests stapled together with one sentence on the front. The strip shows the staple.

panels.composition: The classroom, final day. Students with blue books. The INSTRUCTOR collecting. WOOD at the back with a stack of twelve digests stapled thick.

image.prompt: a classroom on exam day with adult students handing in blue books and a young man at the back holding a thick stapled stack of small booklets, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The stack's front: one sentence in the display face. The strip draws it too small to read.

image.prompt: close on a thick stack of stapled photocopied booklets with one line of hand-lettering on the front too small to read, black and white, no words
image.notes: The thesis sentence: reserved. Letter after: nothing legible.

panels.composition: The instructor taking it. Weighing it in her hand. Reading the sentence.

image.prompt: a woman instructor weighing a thick stapled stack of booklets in her hand and reading its cover, black and white, no words

balloons.text: You're auditing, Mr. Finch. Nothing's a pass.

image.prompt: a woman instructor's face bent over a stack of booklets, dry, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Twelve digests, one sentence. 'Nothing's a pass.'
